data.name: Ascend to Immortal Throne - 问鼎仙台
data.detailed_description:
✅ Overview

"Ascend to Immortal Throne" is a cultivation RPG.

You can walk the path of a rogue cultivator — free and unbound — seeking opportunities, uncovering ancient legacies, and pursuing eternal life and the Great "Dao".

Or you may join a sect, cultivate alongside fellow disciples, refine pills and artifacts, draw talismans, set formations, raise spirit beasts, and fight your way through sect wars to gain a deeper understanding of the "Dao".

Anyone can cultivate immortality — the Golden Core is only the beginning.

✅ About This Game

"Ascend to Immortal Throne" is a cultivation RPG about defying fate as a mortal.

Experience a rich world of sects, aerial combat, and Five Elements strategy — all in an immersive story-driven adventure.

You are born with poor spiritual roots and rejected by the immortal sects.

But you refuse to accept destiny.

Starting from the lowest tier of the world, you seek your own opportunities, learn from wandering cultivators, and carve out your own path in a ruthless cultivation world.

Once you meet the requirements to join a sect, you may cultivate alongside fellow disciples — while also competing for resources, status, and opportunities.

Though you walk alone, the world around you is never silent — sects react, rivals remember, and every choice shapes your path.

It is a world where even the weak can rise — but every step forward comes at a price.

🏯 Sects: Your Faction—and Your Rivals

Multiple sect factions exist in the game, and you will join one upon entering.

Sects are in constant conflict, competing for territory and resources

Each sect has a clear hierarchy and promotion system

Status, resources, and advancement slots must all be fought for

👉 You may grow under the protection of your sect
👉 Or be replaced by those once beside you

Fellow disciples are more than allies.

📈 Progression System: From Servant to Supreme Leader

You begin at the lowest rank:

Novice → Servant Disciple → Outer Disciple → Inner Disciple → Core Disciple → Prodigy → Elder → Sect Master Supreme

Every promotion requires strength and contribution

High-tier resources and positions are limited

Not everyone will reach the top

👉 No one rises through connections
👉 Your position can be taken at any moment

⚔️ Sect Wars: Massive Battles for the Immortal Throne

Sect wars are a core gameplay feature:

Dozens of sects on the same battlefield

Capture the Immortal Throne to gain buffs and resources for your entire sect

Strategy matters: command, flanking, ambushes, and coordinated assaults

👉 Victory means the rise of your entire sect
👉 Defeat comes at a cost for everyone

Grudges never fade—they carry into the next battle.

🌌 Aerial Combat: Beyond the Ground

Combat is no longer limited to the ground.

Under certain conditions, you can take to the skies:

Aerial pursuit

Casting techniques mid-air

Diving into battle from above

Combat expands from 2D into true 3D—
position itself becomes a decisive advantage.

🧠 Combat System: Five Elements, Strategy First

The game uses a Five Elements counter system:

Metal → Wood → Earth → Water → Fire → Metal

Elemental counters directly affect battle outcomes

Choosing the wrong path can put you at a disadvantage before combat begins

Coordination and formations outweigh raw stats

👉 This is a combat system driven by strategy and decision-making

Cultivation Realm Progression:

Body Refining → Qi Refining → Foundation Establishment → Illusory Core → Golden Core → Nascent Soul → Deity Transformation.

🧪 Cultivation Systems: More Than Combat

Cultivation is not just about fighting—it’s about mastering resources and abilities:

Alchemy: Recovery, breakthroughs, sustained combat

Artifact Forging: Equipment and power growth

Formations: Game-changing battlefield control

Talismans: Combat boosts and burst power

Spirit Beasts: Loyal companions in battle

👉 Each system is your foundation within the sect
👉 And your leverage to climb higher

🌿 Five Elements World: Multiple Paths to Power

There are seven types of spiritual roots:

Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, Lightning, Wind

Single-element specialization: maximum damage potential

Multi-element cultivation: adaptability in combat

Formation synergy: stronger teamwork with sect members

👉 There is no single strongest path—only the one that suits you best

🔚 On the “Dao”

Anyone can walk the path of cultivation.

But those who truly ascend to the Immortal Throne have always been few—perhaps you are one of them.

Ascend to Immortal Throne

Everyone has a spiritual root within their body,

Don't say the mortal path is at an end.

And entrust this body to the long night,

Never mind how many winters have passed at the immortal door.

Traversed countless mountains and rivers,

The cultivated heart grows redder with each passing day.

One day, he will ascend to the immortal platform,

A sword pierces the sky with its icy coldness.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 6500 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 or AMD RX 480 with 4+ GB
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Suggest using a solid-state drive
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 12600 or AMD Ryzen 7 7840H
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 2070 or AMD RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Suggest using a solid-state drive
